text: anna: Heads upI9m going to break the /docs -> /docs/v2.2 work into 4 PRs this afternoon: core EN move, redirects, locales (es + ja), regenerate SDK examples. Need reviewers and a merge order that keeps previews stable. Targeting 17:00 PT for PR #1. li: Agree with split. Two risks: linkcheck anchors in locales and preview timeouts. Recommend redirects land before locales and use temporary 302s. tom: I can review core EN move. Will do a quick pass and leave comments for follow-ups. maya: I9ll take redirects. Note: spanish headings changed in a couple files so anchors broke (e.g., #getting-started -> ## Getting started). preview-bot: Preview created for PR 7215: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-7215 (core move). Snapshot: /docs/v2.2/index.html ci-bot: linkcheck: FAILED in preview PR 7216 (redirects): es/intro.md -> anchor "#getting-started" not found. anna: Plan update: merge order = core (7215) -> quick link-sweep on main -> redirects (7216) with temporary HTML shim anchors where needed -> locales (7217/7218) -> snippets (7219). Add note: all shims must include TODO and ticket ref. li: Shim example I9ll add to affected files: tom: Fine as long as we track cleanup. Also gate merges to post-12:00 UTC merge window. maya: Shim pushed to PR 7216 with TODO and ticket. Running `yarn docs:linkcheck --only-anchors es/**` locally before asking for review. preview-bot: PR 7216 updated: redirects file placed at /platform/_redirects-v2.2. ci-bot: linkcheck retried 2/3 due to network timeouts; PR 7215 passed after retries. PR 7216 shows shim present so warnings suppressed. anna: Assignments: tom -> 7215, maya -> 7216, li -> 7217/7218 (es/ja), julia -> 7219 (snippets). Merge order enforced. Everyone: include "Merge window: post-12:00 UTC" in PRs and ping me when green. tom: Approved and merged 7215 at 16:48 PT. docs-bot: PR 7215 merged - snapshot: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/snapshot/7215 ci-bot: site-wide anchor sweep triggered on main; creating follow-up tasks for mismatches. maya: Redirects PR 7216 green with shims; merging now. Monitoring canary (5%). docs-bot: PR 7216 merged - redirects active at 5% canary. Rollback plan: revert redirects and re-deploy. li: es PR 7217 open; found 4 anchor mismatches and added fixes. ja PR 7218 coming next. julia: Preparing snippet regen: `make gen-snippets BASE_PATH=/docs/v2.2` and will run `./scripts/check-snippet-links.sh ` after locales merge. ci-bot: Reminder: create cleanup PR to remove TEMP shim anchors and update heading IDs after rollout. anna: Good job. We'll document this orchestration pattern: core -> redirects (use 302 + shim) -> locales -> snippets. Always schedule cleanup PR and use merge windows.
